about: Arm 3 (the real chatbot app, typed in by the owner; answers verbatim in head_to_head_manual.md), transcribed BY HAND into the shape the scorer reads. App/model: not stated by owner; date 2026-11-15. Products came as shopping cards with titles and prices but no URLs, so links are 'not given'. Rules used: one outfit per complete look the answer offers; where it says 'X, or swap for Y' or 'X or Y', X is taken; layers marked optional are left out; accessories are kept when listed as part of the look. Piece names are copied as written; head_to_head.py matches them to closet labels in code. The 'says the closet cannot' check runs in code on the full answer text from the .md file.

beach.note: The answer is a packing list plus three 'Easy Daytime Outfit Combos'; the combos are scored.

black_tie.note: The burgundy lehenga is named alone as 'a statement piece', with no shoes: not counted as an outfit.
